title: How many branches does Rinzai Zen have? Fourteen or fifteen, source by source

steps.note: 12 sources (the Rinzai–Ōbaku Council, three Wikipedia pages, seven Kotobank dictionaries), each read twice; every full list has the same fourteen; the three Rinzai fifteens add Kōshō-ji, the Council's fifteen adds Manpuku-ji (Ōbaku). 14 checks, all ok; Mypedia broken on purpose turned 3 red.

After Quill's finish: read the Council's English page's own list twice (the page both English Wikipedia articles cite): the same fifteen as the Japanese page, no Kōshō-ji. Added its old forms 禪 圓 覺 國 to the spelling fold, a check that the Council's two pages agree, and named check 9 as half typed. 15 checks, all ok; the same 3 went red when Mypedia was broken again.
